column1: # Types are exactly u8 u16 u32 u64 i32 i64 bytes args, little-endian. `bytes`
# is a u32 length then the bytes, and decodes to two fields: the length under
# the fifth column's name and the bytes under the field's name. `args` is a u8
# count then tagged values: tag 0 a scalar i64, tag 1 a buffer as `bytes`; it
# decodes to `argc` and `args` (the text form: scalars as decimal, buffers as
# x<hex>, comma-separated). Every record has the common header
#   u32 magic "SPTR"; u16 schema_version; u16 kind; u32 body_len; u32 seq; u8 context; u8 entry; u16 pad
# and body_len is exactly the bytes of the fields below. The C recorder
# header (recorder.h) is generated from this file; the Ruby decoder reads it;
# tests/app/fixtures/trace/ holds one byte fixture per kind.
